items.quote: Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold behind him a ram caught in a thicket by his horns
items.claim: Abraham looked up and saw a ram caught in a thicket behind him
items.action: lifted up his eyes and looked

items.quote: Abraham went and took the ram
items.claim: Abraham went and took the ram

items.quote: Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son
items.claim: Abraham offered the ram as a burnt offering in place of his son
items.mechanism: burnt offering in the stead of his son
